n: Civic Data Project (TERC and Boston University)
t: Civic datasets for middle school social studies, formatted for the CODAP tool.
steps: Open the Civic Data Project page.
Join the mailing list through the Get Access link.
Wait for the datasets by email.
Load a dataset and look at it yourself.
Try a graph routine such as Slow Reveal Graphs.
Plan a first lesson with one dataset.
